item.title: Crack uneven damage, 22nd August
item.description:
Urgent request for repair of dangerous and deteriorating pavement I would like to report the very poor condition of the pavement along my street and request that it is inspected and repaired. The pavement has extensive cracking, uneven sections, broken and raised slabs and numerous damaged areas which create potential trip and fall hazards. The deterioration appears to extend along a considerable length of the pavement and has been getting progressively worse over approximately the last two years. I am particularly concerned about the risk to elderly residents, children, people with mobility difficulties, wheelchair users and anyone who is visually impaired, as the uneven surfaces and cracks are difficult to navigate safely. The photographs attached show several areas where the pavement is badly cracked and uneven. There are also sections where previous repairs appear to have deteriorated. I would ask the council to please arrange an inspection of the whole stretch of pavement, rather than only repairing one individual crack, as the problem appears to be widespread. Please could you confirm that this has been logged as a highway safety issue and advise when an inspection and repairs are likely to take place? Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Mottingham Road, Coldharbour, Greater London
